name: GMFlow policy
plain: The model predicts a Gaussian mixture over the clean image at the start of the step. At any later point the policy works out the mean of that mixture given where the latent has moved, then turns it into a velocity. So the policy adapts as it integrates, at no model cost.
math:
From output (means u_k, logstds, logweights): μ_k=x_src−σ_src u_k, v_k=e^(2·logstd)σ_src².
ζ=(α/σ)²−(α_s/σ_s)², ν=(α/σ)x/σ−(α_s/σ_s)x_s/σ_s, α=1−σ.
μ′_k=(v_k ν+μ_k)/(v_k ζ+1). logw′_k=logw_k+Σ_c μ_k(ν−½ζ μ_k)/(v_k ζ+1).
x̂₀=Σ softmax(logw′)_k μ′_k; π=(x−x̂₀)/σ.
Temperature T<1: logw←log_softmax(logw/T), v←v·T.
